Kloppenheim 03 (Pure Sky)
Original photography: Greg Zaal. Sky edits: Jarod Guest.

Redistributed file: kloppenheim_03_puresky_2k.hdr
Downloaded unchanged from Poly Haven's public 2K HDR download.
This is a photographed sky used for generic daylight and reflections. It is not
a photograph of Gangnam, current weather, or a measured Seoul lighting record.

circuit-blue-hour.jpg is an original colour treatment of the same CC0
photograph for the fictional racing circuit. Decode the HDR to linear RGB.
Feather adjacent photographed clouds over the high daytime sun, then use
log luminance and blue chromaticity to preserve cloud texture. Interpolate
an indigo zenith (sRGB 30,45,85) to a slate horizon (115,142,177), with a
localized warm afterglow at the original solar azimuth. Resample the full
panorama to 1536 x 768 and encode as an sRGB JPEG.
